name: Nazir
description: Cruel Felonarch of Nohr, cursed with madness, who kidnaps Aylith.

description_citations.text: "The Cursed Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Inys Nohr, Nazir enchants Aylith into revealing the Memories; Feryar shows her the last branch of the Tree.
timeline.quote: enchanted her into revealing that she carried the Memories of the Clan Tree

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir strikes Aylith down with Soulslayer; Feryar carries her away.
timeline.quote: Nazir struck her down with Soulslayer

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith chooses peace over vengeance and heals Nazir of his family's curse.
timeline.quote: healed him of his family's curse

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith and Nazir recite the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending the fighting.
timeline.quote: a new sapling Clan Tree took root, restoring balance to the plane

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Year 520, Aylith and Nazir mend the Clan Tree and the seasons return to normal.
timeline.quote: Keeper Aylith and Felonarch Nazir descendants of Haen and Nohr, mended the Clan Tree .

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith breaks the curse on Nazir and together they recreate the Clan Tree from the last acorn, fulfilling Haen's prophecy.
timeline.quote: the Keeper Aylith used her powers to break the curse on Nazir .

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir has a prophetic vision of what the plane will look like in 1000 years.
timeline.quote: the healed wizard Nazir had a prophetic vision of what the plane would look like 1000 years in the future

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lorris witnesses RoNal's disgrace by Nazir and finds him in a dungeon.
timeline.quote: Lorris witnessed her father RoNal ’s disgrace at the hands of the Felonarch Nazir.

citation.text: "Lorris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lorris aids Aylith and Jedhian's escape and steals a boat with Arn to pursue Nazir.
timeline.quote: She aided Aylith and Jedhian in their escape

citation.text: "Lorris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lorris corners Nazir at Inys Haen but Jedhian persuades her to take him prisoner; Nazir escapes.
timeline.quote: Jedhian intervened, convincing her to take him prisoner instead.

citation.text: "Lorris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith heals Nazir of his madness and the Clan Tree is mended.
timeline.quote: witnessing the return of sunlight and warmth to the land

citation.text: "Lorris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4064 AR Malvos assists Nazir in investigating the raiding party's failure and in interrogating Aylith.
timeline.quote: Malvos assisted Nazir in investigating the failure.

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos goes with Nazir to Inys Haen to force the Awakening Ritual, but Aylith's allies arrive and Nazir flees, leaving Malvos behind.
timeline.quote: Malvos remained behind to control the situation

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir inherits the throne at twenty after his father and grandfather kill each other.
timeline.quote: leaving Nazir to inherit the throne of Inys Nohr at twenty years of age

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir tries to reach Inys Haen but his birthmark burns so badly he must turn back.
timeline.quote: his birthmark burned so badly that he had to turn back

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir's soldiers raid Inys Haen and return with Aylith but not the Keeper alive.
timeline.quote: they failed to bring back the Keeper alive but returned with his young daughter, Aylith

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir interrogates and enchants Aylith to extract the Memories of the Clan Tree.
timeline.quote: He enchanted her to extract this knowledge

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Facing rebellion, Nazir strikes Aylith down with Soulslayer; Feryar carries her away.
timeline.quote: Nazir struck her down with Soulslayer

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir abandons his fortress and assaults Inys Haen; Aylith pursues him.
timeline.quote: Nazir abandoned his fortress and led his best warriors in an assault on Inys Haen

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir is captured; Aylith chooses to heal him of his madness and addiction.
timeline.quote: instead chose to heal him of his madness and addiction

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir assists the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending his reign.
timeline.quote: Nazir assisted in performing the Awakening Ritual alongside Aylith, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir disguised as a servant compels Aylith to reveal she holds the Memories of the Clan Tree.
timeline.quote: She is enchanted by Nazir, still disguised as a servant, and is magically compelled to reveal to him the truth about her abilities as Keeper

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "In the hands of Nazir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebellion erupts; Nazir runs Aylith through with Soulslayer and Feryar carries her away.
timeline.quote: She tries to form a protective wall with her magic but the enraged Felonarch runs her through with Soulslayer—right above the heart.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "Flight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir and Malvos secretly depart to strike Inys Haen.
timeline.quote: Fearing the rebellion, Nazir and Malvos take their best forces and secretly depart Inys Nohr to strike Inys Haen

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "Flight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aylith heals Nazir's madness; they recite the ritual and the Clan Tree is mended.
timeline.quote: A small sapling Clan Tree arises and the plane's balance is restored.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Broke his curse and mended the tree with him.
